meta.source: NAAS Policy Paper 42 (state -> agroclimatic zone / soil type mapping) plus NBSS&LUP / NCERT standard India soil-type classification
meta.note: stateZones maps a state name to its agroclimatic zone and dominant soil type(s), used to match a farm's saved location text. soilTypes gives general characteristics of each broad Indian soil class.

Chhattisgarh.soilTypes: Red & yellow, Red & lateritic, Mixed red & black

Jharkhand.soilTypes: Red & yellow, Red & lateritic, Mixed red & black

Eastern Maharashtra & Odisha.soilTypes: Red & yellow, Red & lateritic, Mixed red & black

soilTypes.coverage: ~40% of India's land - Indo-Gangetic plains (Punjab, Haryana, UP, Bihar, West Bengal, parts of Assam), river deltas
soilTypes.characteristics: Rich in potash, phosphoric acid and lime; low in nitrogen and organic matter; fine-grained, very fertile; renewed by river silt deposits

soilTypes.coverage: Deccan trap region - Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Gujarat, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu
soilTypes.characteristics: High clay content, retains moisture very well, rich in calcium carbonate, magnesium, potash; low in nitrogen, phosphorus and organic matter; cracks deeply when dry

soilTypes.coverage: Eastern and southern Deccan plateau - Odisha, Chhattisgarh, parts of Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Jharkhand
soilTypes.characteristics: Red color from iron oxide; sandy to loamy texture; low in nitrogen, phosphorus and humus; needs fertilizer input for good yield

soilTypes.coverage: High rainfall areas - Kerala, Karnataka (coastal), parts of Odisha, West Bengal, Northeast India
soilTypes.characteristics: Formed by heavy leaching in high rainfall; low in nitrogen, phosphate, calcium, magnesium; high in iron and aluminium oxide
Sandy, low organic matter, low water retention, often saline; nutrient-poor without irrigation

soilTypes.coverage: Patches in Punjab, Haryana, UP, Gujarat, Maharashtra - mostly poorly drained irrigated tracts
soilTypes.characteristics: High salt content, poor drainage, low fertility, difficult for most crops without reclamation (gypsum treatment)
